title: What Happened Before History? Human Origins
summary: Kurzgesagt's animated overview of human origins and the vast prehistory before recorded history. It covers how modern humans emerged and spread.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a compact, well-sourced intro to human evolution that even led one viewer to read Sapiens.

quote.text: there is a great 10 minute video from the Youtube Kurzgesagt channel that lead me to read Sapiens.
